name: camera
description: A compact camera with a continuous curved body and circular lens.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Rounded rectangular body uses the Folder corner rhythm. The left and right shoulders have explicit 3-unit horizontal ledges at y=6.8 (x=5..8 and x=16..19), with a narrower raised housing to keep both straight spans visible. The indicator is a circular stroke mark centered at 17.9,9.5 with radius 0.15; it stays a solid circular dot across the Thin/Regular/Bold presets. The circular lens is centered at 12,13.2. Source bounds x=3..21 and y=4.1..19.9 balance opposite margins. Review study; not owner-approved.
